sense.text:
“A lie is a foul blot in a man, yet it is continually in the mouth of the untaught.” Another word for lies is slander, and some lie for no reason at all. There are different forms of lying. Some lie because they are afraid, like Sarah before the angels: asked whether she had said it, she said she had not. She lied because she was afraid.

Then there is the lie told to deceive and to destroy. To lie and say a person committed adultery is a lie to destroy that person, because the judgment for adultery is death.

“A thief is better than a man that is accustomed to lie: but they both shall have destruction to heritage.” God puts the man accustomed to lying beneath the thief.

So the leaders in the schools are not to play with lies told to destroy. A sister once said a brother pushed her going up the stairs. The judgment for putting hands on anyone inside the school is to be put out, so the cameras were checked, and the sister was lying: the brother never pushed her. Someone could just as well lie and say the deacon touched them. Brothers and sisters who make false accusations to destroy and to deceive are to be put out. Let them learn online.
“The disposition of a liar is dishonourable, and his shame is ever with him.” That shame is always going to be with the liar.

“Marriage is honourable in all”. A marriage does not just become honourable because two people got married. It becomes honourable when both the brother and the sister apply the scriptures, love thy neighbour as thyself, love each other and deal right with each other. A house where they are fighting and arguing all the time, with hatred toward each other, speaking evil about each other and no love in it, is not an honourable marriage.

Being an Israelite married to an Israelite sister does not make a marriage honourable, because some are dishonourable brothers and dishonourable sisters: evil, vessels to dishonour, hating each other and then calling themselves married and followers of Christ. That is fake and phony.

Leadership counsels a couple once, twice, about the same matter. If it is not fixed after that, they are not listening, and the leaders are to stop counseling those dishonourable, hateful brothers and sisters: let them learn online. The job of leadership is to give the scriptures to help people fix themselves; leadership cannot fix them. The ones who see their own faults go home and fix it and never come back. The ones always looking for someone to blame turn around and blame leadership.

precepts.why:
“For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?” It is not up to leadership to rule a man’s house for him, and it is not their job to tell his wife to respect him. It is his job to rule his own damn house.

Some sisters come and complain all the time that the husband is not doing this or that. Leadership can tell the brother to fix it, but it is up to him to fix it. Sisters, leadership cannot force your husband to love you: be a good wife and use your womanliness to get your husband to love you. Brothers, leadership cannot make your wife respect you and love you: you have to figure out how to fix that.

So a man who cannot rule his own house has no business leaning on the church to do it, and the ones who keep coming back with the same matter, both hateful to each other, are wasting the leaders’ time.

sense.text:
Trump ran on peace, on ending endless wars, and since he got into office it has been war after war. What happened to him? “This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men”. God is the one ruling in the kingdom of men. Whatever you see taking place on this earth, the Lord is behind it, so that those of us living may know it. Trump talks about peace, but God wants war. When Trump gets up and bombs Iran, the Lord is behind that.

“and giveth it to whomsoever he will”. At one time he gave the earth to the ancient Babylonians. Then he gave it to the second beast, the Persians: that same Iran ruled the whole earth one time. Then he gave it to the Greeks, then to the Romans, and America is an extension of Rome, America and Europe. The people ruling this earth were given rulership by God.

“and setteth up over it the basest of men.” The men ruling this earth are the lowest of men. It is as the scripture says, kings as servants and servants on horses: we are the kings, but we are at the bottom of society. The basest of men is the Epstein class, the pedophiles, the ones eating kids and having sex with little babies and little boys. Princes, high government officials and the rulers of this world were all caught up in that Epstein file pedophile ring. That is the basest of men God set up to rule this earth.

precepts.why:
This is how God rules in the kingdom of men. “The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord”. Whatever king or ruler is on this earth, his heart, meaning his mind, is in the hand of the Lord.

“as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” As water flows, God turns the king’s heart however he will. Whether the Lord wants peace or war, whether he wants them to sign a peace treaty or to drop a nuclear bomb on Iran, the Lord is behind it.

That is what is going on with Trump. He ran on a peace platform, stop the endless wars, and ever since he got into office it has been chaos, war after war, bombing people. Why is he doing it? Because God wants him to. Don’t be mad and confused when you see these things: God is behind it.

“Man’s goings are of the Lord”. That is true for every one of us, even our coming into this truth. Trump becoming the president of the United States of America was of the Lord.

“how can a man then understand his own way?” A man cannot understand why he did this or that. Pharaoh in Egypt could not understand why he let Israel go, and then turned around to go after them to kill them and bring them back. The Lord put those thoughts in his mind: God hardened his heart so he would not let us go, softened it when he killed his firstborn so that Pharaoh said leave, all of you go, then hardened it again so he would come after us and be made an example.

So everything Trump does is of the Lord.

Here is an example of God ruling in the kingdom of men. “O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong.” Daniel was greatly beloved, and this is Christ, the Lord, speaking to Daniel.

“Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.” The prince of Grecia is the Greeks, Alexander. The Lord was creating war, setting up the Greeks to conquer the Persians. Every time a kingdom is set up, the spirit at the top of it ruling is Satan, and that spirit in the king of Persia was resisting, trying to stop the Greeks from coming into power. The Lord was making things happen in the spiritual realm, which cannot be seen, so the Greeks would come into power and prophecy would be fulfilled. It is a transfer of power. “there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince”: Michael, our prince.

That is what it means that the Lord rules in the kingdom of men. The Lord and the angels are doing things behind the scenes, guiding people to do things. The Lord had Trump go and bomb the Iranians, the modern-day Persians. Trump killed the Ayatollah, the supreme leader, and his family with him: when Esau comes, they kill everything. He killed different tiers of the leadership of Iran, Larijani among them, one of their top scholars and the head of their security. And for every action there is a reaction.

Why did the Lord have them eliminated? The Ayatollah had a fatwa, a religious decree in Islamic law that everybody has to follow, against the making of nuclear weapons in Iran. While the whole world says Iran is getting a nuclear weapon, he was not a hardliner: he was against Iran having nuclear capability, and they were about to make a deal to give up their enriched uranium to America. That was going against God’s prophecies. The Lord wants Iran to have nuclear weapons, so the Lord put a spirit on Trump to kill them, and the leaders who rise up after them will be hardliners, and all of them want revenge.

sense.text:
“Declaring the end from the beginning”. The Most High declared from the beginning what is going to happen in the end. The prophets prophesied about war. They prophesied what Iran is going to do to the Israelis, and that Iran will acquire nuclear capability, no matter what America does.

“and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand”. Whatever God says is going to come to pass, and nobody can stop it: not the Ayatollah, not Trump. “and I will do all my pleasure”: the Lord is going to do whatever he wants to do.

precepts.why:
“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war”. That is our job: to prophesy against many countries and great kingdoms, of war. Is war going to Europe? Yes. Will there be war in Iran, in the Middle East? Yes. Will there be war here in America? Yes. We do it by going into the Bible and bringing out what the scriptures say.

“and of evil, and of pestilence.” A lot of evil is coming on this earth, and pestilence.

“The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the Lord hath truly sent him.” Some talk about peace, but there will be no peace. Anyone who says there will be peace in the Middle East is lying. There will be no two-state solution in the land of Israel either: the Palestinians will never have their own land.

sense.text:
“Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the Lord, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant”. The Lord calls the king of Babylon his servant. The most High rules in the kingdom of men and has the king do whatever he wants that king to do, and Nebuchadnezzar is the analogy of Trump today.

“and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about”. He brings his armies against the land, and the nations round about are Palestine, the Philistines, Lebanon. The Lord raises up his servant Nebuchadnezzar to do it. “and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment”: he would utterly destroy all the land neighbouring Israel.

So the Lord used Nebuchadnezzar to bring judgment on all the nations around Jerusalem back then, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, all of them, and the Lord is doing the same thing with Trump today. Lebanon is going to get it; all of them are going to get it. History repeats itself. Further on, the chapter goes into the cup the Lord gives all the nations to drink, and into Christ coming back, so it is twofold: ancient Babylon, and also spiritual Babylon in these last days.

Jeremiah showed ancient Babylon; Isaiah 14 is spiritual Babylon, which is America. The same way God raised up Nebuchadnezzar, his servant, to oppress and afflict and destroy the land of Israel, our people and all the neighbouring cities, America is going to do the same today.

“in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”. The Lord is giving rest to the Israelites, not to all nations. That rest is the kingdom of heaven: the Lord rested on the seventh day, and that rest is for the children of Israel.

“thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”. The thou is us. We are the ones taking up this proverb, saying what happened to America, because the king of Babylon is America.

“How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” This is what we say when we are at rest: how did the oppressor, America, get destroyed? It is called the oppressor because, as ancient Babylon oppressed all nations as God’s servant, America oppresses all nations.
“The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers”: the governments.

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”. That is what ancient Babylon did, and it is the same thing Trump is doing today. They always were the oppressor, but now they do it openly, where everybody can see, and he doesn’t care. America is going to bring its wrath down on all nations and smite them continually, and it is not going to stop.

“he that ruled the nations in anger”. Iran does not want to make America angry. Right now the Iranians are taunting Trump, trolling him with AI videos, and they are no backward people: they are very smart, they are Elam. But if they make him angry he will blow up their nuclear power plant and cause a nuclear fallout over Iran.

“is persecuted, and none hindereth”: nobody cares. This is the saints, those who make it out of here, talking when this world is ended and we are ruling. We are rehearsing it now from what we see today.
“The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.” When America is destroyed, the whole earth is going to be at rest and quiet, and everybody singing.

“and the cedars of Lebanon”. Right now over 1,200 people have been murdered in Lebanon. The Israeli army is advancing and has taken half of Lebanon, southern Lebanon, and says it is not giving it back. Millions have been displaced. America and Israel will always be fighting against Lebanon because the Israelis want that land, and the Lord is behind it.

“Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.” This is the Lebanese people saying: since America and Israel are destroyed, nobody comes up against us.

“Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth”. This goes into the nations and the kings of the earth rising up to destroy Israel and America. Hell from beneath is the chief ones of the earth: the kings of the earth will rise up against Israel and America for all the evil they are doing on the earth.
“Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?” That is the nations telling the white men: you have become weak like us.

“Thy pomp is brought down to the grave”. That pride is brought down. This chapter is about when the Lord gives us rest: all the nations will look at white people and say, at one time you were ruling the earth, you were prideful, look at you now.

“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” That Lucifer is America: the lightbearer, the morning star.

“how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” America weakens the nations through sanctions, through war, through their policies. For decades they sanctioned Iran, but Iran went around the sanctions and built a very powerful military. So, unable to weaken Iran through sanctions, they went to war with them, saying they had to stop their ballistic missile capabilities.

“I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”: that shows it is America, the first to do space travel. “I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”: the mount of the congregation is North America, where they sit upon the twelve tribes of Israel.
“I will ascend above the heights of the clouds”: they are the ones who invented airplanes. “I will be like the most High”: they set themselves up as God and as the people of God.
“Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit”: brought down to a low state.

“They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man”. So Lucifer is a man: the white man.

“that made the earth to tremble”. That is how America and Israel make war: they fly their planes over your country and drop tomahawk missiles and bombs, and they make the earth tremble. That is what they are doing to Iran right now. “that did shake kingdoms”: right now the kingdom of the Persians is being shaken.

“That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof”. Look at Palestine, look at Libya: they look like a wilderness, destroyed by the bombs America and Israel dropped on them. The whole of Palestine is destroyed, now they are destroying the cities in Iran, and it is just the beginning.

“that opened not the house of his prisoners”. We are the prisoners. A lot of Negroes think they are free, but we are still slaves here in Babylon. We have been conditioned to live a certain way and no longer see the slavery and the oppression, because we were born into it and live it every day.

“All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.” Everyone is going to be put back in his own land. The Arabs in Egypt have to go: everybody goes back to the land we tell them is theirs.

“what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?” These are the signs we have to look for before Christ returns. Trump went into office talking about being the president of peace who would not start any war, but the king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord.

“Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” That is the Judeo-Christian religion: the people who say they are Jews and are not, being put in that land.

“And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.” The wars go hand in hand with the deceivers of verse 5: a lot of the wars are going to take place because of them, the people who say they are Jews and are not, being put in that land.

“For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.” Wars, famine, pestilence and earthquakes must all take place before Christ returns, and the scriptures show who is behind all of it.

precepts.why:
“As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.” Because Babylon killed the saints, at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth: America is going to be responsible for all the wars taking place on the earth. No matter which president goes into office, he is going to do what God wants him to do.

Who was behind the Russia and Ukraine war? America. It is the Lord, but the Lord is using Babylon, America. The war began because America kept dangling the carrot of NATO in Ukraine’s eyes, promising to protect them from Russia, and then Trump came into office and said we are not helping you with anything. Trump is fulfilling God’s prophecies.

“And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down”. That great city Babylon is America, and Babylon is going to be responsible for all the slain of the earth, all the wars taking place.

“And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints”. The prophets and the saints will be killed here in Babylon. “and of all that were slain upon the earth”: all the wars and death taking place on the earth, Babylon will be the cause of it. America, the oppressor.

It is the same way ancient Babylon came through, Nebuchadnezzar killing everybody, and the one behind Nebuchadnezzar doing all those things was the Lord, with angels working alongside his army. America will be responsible for all the deaths and wars on the earth, and the same way Nebuchadnezzar fulfilled God’s prophecy, America will do the same.

sense.text: “And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.” The fourth seal is wars and rumours of wars, the beginning of sorrows: the Lord using America to bring famine, death and destruction on the earth.

“And I looked, and behold a pale horse”. That pale horse is America. “and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him.” Death and hell are America and its wars: this man brings death and destruction wherever he goes. It is the oppressor, and no matter which president gets into office, they fulfill it.

Much of this was done in secret over the last fifty or sixty years and is now being made openly manifest by Trump. Obama did the same, but nobody knew: Obama went over there and killed Gaddafi, who was trying to uplift the people of Libya, and nobody said anything because Obama was a black man. Trump is doing it openly. Since 1971, by their own admission, America’s sanctions, policies and wars murdered 38 million people, starving whole nations to make them rise up against their governments, in Iraq, Venezuela, Cuba and Iran. Their wickedness is being revealed, and what is about to take place will be billions dying.

“And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth”. America is the fourth part of the earth: the book The Fourth Part of the World tells of the birth of America. The Monroe Doctrine, which Trump changed to the Donroe Doctrine, says America rules the fourth part of the earth, the Western Hemisphere: Cuba, Venezuela, Colombia. Trump is reinforcing it, telling China and Russia to stay out. So the fourth part of the earth points to the king of Babylon, the oppressor, with rulership over the fourth part of the earth.

“to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.” Their job is to kill. A lot of people will be killed with war, famine and death, and America will be responsible for all of it. That is the beginning of sorrows of Matthew 24, wars and rumours of wars, and it goes back to Nebuchadnezzar: he came and oppressed and destroyed everyone, and America is doing the same thing.

precepts.why:
Habakkuk explains that hell is America. “For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie”. The vision is the prophecy that is going to come to pass, and we are living in that time: we are seeing it take place right now. “it will not tarry”: it is not going to take long.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”. This is the white man. God says that race of people, their soul is not right, and yet some want to save him. “but the just shall live by his faith.”

“Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man”. Look how proud and arrogant Trump talks. “neither keepeth at home”: America is never in its own country. It has military bases all over the earth, in everybody’s country, dictating to them what to do and oppressing them.

“who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death”. When he goes into other countries he enlarges his desire as hell, and he is as death. That is what Revelation 6 reads: wherever America goes, the people catch hell and he brings death. In some form or fashion, directly or indirectly, America will be responsible for the wars of the last days, the number one supplier of weapons over all the earth, then Russia, then China.

sense.text:
“Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment.” Scourges are a whipping. Amendment is correction: making changes for the better in one’s behaviour, actions or spiritual state, closely joined to repentance and correction. Don’t guess at a word: pull it up and understand it.

So all these wars, famine, tribulation and anguish are sent for correction. A lot of bad things are about to take place on this earth: pestilence, war, death, famine. America is going to do these things to our people, but it is for us to ask ourselves why these things happen and to seek the Lord early. If America were just nice to our people all the time, they would say they are good. God is turning it up: he is using Trump to bring forth prophecies, for correction, to start wars, and to bring famine on this earth, because the pale horse’s job is to bring death.

“But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness”. Millions died of the coronavirus; people saw the bombs dropping in Palestine, Russia and Ukraine, and now Iran. Have our people changed? No. They are doing dumb TikTok videos shaking their ass and thinking about going to the club. A lot of our people will not change, and the nations will not change either; they will keep doing their evil.

“nor be alway mindful of the scourges.” How often does the coronavirus run through your mind now? Rarely. When people were dropping dead, people prayed not to die and kept six feet away from everybody, and now it is forgotten.

“Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case”. Victuals are goods: food, merchandise, clothing. Things are cheap, so people think they are good: I have a good job, I can afford food, gas is two dollars a gallon. But that time of cheap victuals is passing. If victuals stayed cheap, would there be famine?

“and even then shall evils grow upon earth, sword, famine, and great confusion.” Even when you think everything is good, evils multiply on the earth. The sword is war, multiplying: Russia, Ukraine, Lebanon, Israel, Palestine, Iran. Then famine and great confusion.

We have not been taught to think on a geopolitical stage, like rulers think. The pale horse is about to bring famine on this earth. Putin warns that what is taking place in the Middle East will cause a global disaster like the coronavirus, with 45 million people dying of hunger and the world economy destroyed. Iran has taken the Strait of Hormuz and blocked about a fifth of the world’s oil supply, and it is a domino effect: the Philippines declared a national emergency and people are walking to work, gas is rationed and stations empty in Vietnam and India, and there is a gas shortage over all Europe and the world. America cannot leave the war, because if it withdraws the petrodollar and its economy collapse.

This is why our people have been told for years to prepare: food stored for months, and to reach the level of being self-sufficient. Those who believe will prepare. The one who has a job and just bought a new X5 and did not prepare should not come knocking when things get crazy: go eat that X5.

“For many of them that dwell upon earth shall perish of famine; and the other, that escape the hunger, shall the sword destroy.” Many on the earth will die of famine, and some who prepare and escape the hunger will die by war.

Fertilizer is made from gas: urea and ammonia are extracted from it, and farmers all over the world grow their crops with it. About a third of the world’s fertilizer passes through the Strait of Hormuz, and it is closed just as the spring farming season begins. Less fertilizer means smaller harvests and higher food prices. Trump started that war, and because of it famine is coming: you will not feel it today, but give it a couple of weeks and months. That is why Trump cannot just walk away. America is the one behind all of this, and the Lord is behind America doing it.

precepts.why:
Two months earlier the US government kidnapped Maduro and put a blockade on oil going to Cuba. Babies on ventilators are dying, people who are supposed to have surgery are dying, there is no power, and a whole nation of over ten million is being starved, and nobody in the world spoke up: not Europe, not the Filipinos. Trump said he would take Cuba and do whatever he wants with it, and the Lord heard all those prideful words. So God flipped it on all of them: Iran blocked the Strait of Hormuz, and now there is an oil shortage all over the world and Europe is in crisis, because none of them opened their mouth when it was done to Cuba.

“If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.” When you see your people oppressed, and that is our people in Cuba, it should make you mad. America, the oppressor, violently perverts judgment, but he that is higher than the highest, higher than Trump, sees it. Is America about justice and equal rights when it starves a whole nation?

“Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field. He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase”. That is Trump and America: loving silver and wealth, wanting Cuba, never satisfied, wanting more. So the Most High has them in a trick bag: you blocked the oil from Cuba and starved my people, so I will block the oil from the world and starve the world.

Trump said Iran was not supposed to hit the other countries in the Middle East, that they could have yielded: as if they should just let him bomb them and kill their leaders and not fight back. That is how prideful this people is. The Lord was behind Iran striking the countries hosting US militaries and closing the Strait of Hormuz. Now Trump cannot exit, because he said he already won the war, and if he leaves Iran controls everything. So he has to rule in anger: whether a tactical nuclear weapon or the blowing up of their nuclear power plant, he will do what God wants. Teaching this will get us killed, because we stand for truth and justice and call out evil, and they will call us a hate group and anti-American.

sense.text: “Behold, speak thou in the ears of my people the words of prophecy, which I will put in thy mouth, saith the Lord”. That is what we are doing right now: speaking the words of prophecy in the ears of our people, the things that are going to come to pass.
“And cause them to be written in paper: for they are faithful and true.” This is what we are reading, in paper.

“Fear not the imaginations against thee”. Don’t fear the evil things people imagine against us: they call us a hate group. “let not the incredulity of them trouble thee”: incredulity means unbelief. If they don’t believe that famine is coming, that Christ is a black man, that we are the Israelites and Christ is coming to redeem us, don’t let their unbelief trouble you. “that speak against thee”: they will speak against us, because the servant is not greater than his master.

“For all the unfaithful shall die”. Every one of you unfaithful brothers and sisters, every one who hates the word of God, every unrepentant Christian who worships the white man, is going to die in unbelief, believing the oppressor’s lies.

“Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world”. The Lord is the one bringing plagues upon the earth: “the sword”, so war is coming; “famine”, famine is coming and is here; “death, and destruction.”
“For wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth”: that is what you see. “and their hurtful works are fulfilled”: all the hurtful things the white men are doing are fulfilled.

“Therefore saith the Lord, I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness, which they profanely commit, neither will I suffer them in those things, in which they wickedly exercise themselves”. God is not going to be quiet anymore about all the evil the white man is doing on this earth. They call themselves Jews and the people of God, and they enslaved God’s people. It starts with him putting his spirit on us and our teaching, and then he is coming back to deal with them.

precepts.why:
How does the Lord bring the plagues upon the world? “And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword”: they will bring war. “and with hunger”: they will cause famine. “and with death”. This is America.

So when God says I will bring plagues upon the world, he brings them through America, the one causing all these wars. Trump came into office saying he was about peace, but he is going to do what God wants: bring affliction on all nations, bring affliction on the Iranians, kill the Ayatollah who would not do what God wanted. Trump thinks he is doing something good, but he is really fulfilling God’s will. That is the trick bag.

The Lord is sending plagues on the earth. “All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.”

“There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them.” God creates spirits for vengeance. The time of destruction is famine, death, plagues and wars, and in it those spirits pour out their force.

Who are those spirits created for vengeance? “And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.” The Lord makes his angels spirits: the spirits created for vengeance are the angels.

“And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.” The angels are the ones pouring out the wrath of God upon the earth, the spirits created for vengeance. Read the whole chapter and it goes into war, civil war, world war. The Lord is behind all of it, doing it through the angels, instigating it all in a way we cannot see. When you see America bombing Iran and killing the Palestinians, the Lord is behind that.

They just poured some of that vial upon Trump. In one year he got rid of DEI hiring and affirmative action and black history in the schools, talked of deporting people and taking away citizenship: the man is on a rampage, because God put that spirit on him. A lot of our people have the American dream and think this place is their rest. May the Lord give Trump more years: if he is the one to fulfill God’s will, let him stay in office and keep fulfilling God’s prophecies, even if he is the one who starts putting us to death. Let God’s will be done.

sense.text: “Woe be unto thee, Babylon, and Asia! woe be unto thee, Egypt, and Syria!” Woe means death and destruction unto them. Asia is the Middle East: they call Palestine and that region West Asia.

“Gird up yourselves with cloths of sack and hair, bewail your children, and be sorry; for your destruction is at hand.” Put on sackcloth and mourn and cry, all you Palestinians: your destruction is at hand. America and Israel are about to destroy a lot of them over there, starting with Iran. Iran will not be fully destroyed and will eventually make some agreement; Iran knows it cannot win against America, which has the most powerful military on earth, but Iran is hitting America’s pockets.
“A sword is sent upon you, and who may turn it back?” The sword is war sent among them, and nobody is turning back the war and destruction the Lord is sending upon the nations.

“A fire is sent among you, and who may quench it?” That fire is bombs, and nobody will be able to quench it. Death and famine are coming. How prepared are you? A lot of our people are clueless, worried about their jobs and dumb stuff, while plague, death and destruction take place in front of their eyes and this world is coming to an end.

“Plagues are sent unto you, and what is he that may drive them away?” The Lord is sending the plagues on the nations, and that is what you see Trump doing. Nobody can drive them away. If God wants him to drop a tactical nuclear weapon on Iran or destroy their nuclear power plant, he is going to do it. America and Israel have to be greatly despised, so they have to do some very evil things against international law, for the whole world to hate them.

“May any man drive away an hungry lion”: you can’t drive away a hungry lion; you will get eaten. “or may any one quench the fire in stubble, when it hath begun to burn? May one turn again the arrow that is shot of a strong archer?”

“The mighty Lord sendeth the plagues”. He is the one who sends them; Revelation 16:1 shows the angels pouring the vials upon the earth. “and who is he that can drive them away?” Trump can’t drive them away. JD Vance can’t. You Democrats and liberals could win the House and impeach Trump out of office, and the next president is going to do the same thing, because it is God’s will. A man’s goings are of the Lord.
“A fire shall go forth from his wrath, and who is he that may quench it? He shall cast lightnings, and who shall not fear? he shall thunder, and who shall not be afraid?”

“The Lord shall threaten”. The Lord threatens through us out here speaking, letting them know they are going to be judged for everything: the Lord is coming back to destroy America and Europe and all these cities. That is a threat, and when you prophesy, you are threatening them. Don’t think you can threaten people and live a nice quiet life.

“and who shall not be utterly beaten to powder at his presence?” When he returns, he is going to beat them to powder.
“The earth quaketh, and the foundations thereof; the sea ariseth up with waves from the deep”.

“Behold, the plagues are sent, and shall not return again, until they come upon the earth.” They were sent when the seven angels were given the seven last vials of the wrath of God. In the past ancient Babylon was used to bring death and destruction on all the nations of the earth, and in the same way mystery Babylon is being used now.

“The fire is kindled, and shall not be put out, till it consume the foundation of the earth. Like as an arrow which is shot of a mighty archer returneth not backward: even so the plagues that shall be sent upon earth shall not return again.” Those plagues, famine, death and destruction, are not going back.
“Woe is me! woe is me! who will deliver me in those days?” Ezra said it because Ezra is alive on the earth right now; one of the brothers might be Ezra.

“The beginning of sorrows”. Matthew 24 says the same thing: the wars and rumours of wars are the beginning of sorrows. “and great mournings”: there will be great mourning on this earth, as the people in Palestine are mourning for food right now. “the beginning of famine and great death”: we are living in the beginning of famine, so prepare.

“the beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear”. Everybody will stand in fear asking why Trump is doing this. But those who understand the scriptures say yes, Lord, you’re doing your thing: Iran letting go missiles, America dropping missiles on them, the Strait of Hormuz blocked, oil prices going up and Europe crying. These things should build your faith: everything God said would happen is happening.

“Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.” The plagues will not be slack; everybody on this earth is going to mourn, and sorrows will come on every side. Trinidad, Jamaica and a lot of the Caribbean islands get about 80 percent of their food from abroad, from America. If America falls, everybody all over the world falls.

“O my people, hear my word”. O my people, the twelve tribes of Israel scattered into slavery: hear God’s word, those listening online too. “make you ready to the battle”: God says prepare for what is coming. This is war, and if you believe, you will make ready. It goes back to gathering yourselves together: if you have a little money in the bank, start buying land and building self-sustaining communities, because it is going to get very bad. Don’t sit down and say God’s got me. Get ready for what they are going to do to you, for death, destruction and famine.

“and in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth.” Be ready to up and leave, to another country or another state, when things get hard. You have to be willing to give up the nice house, the nice car, the nice job. Sisters have to mold their minds that way, not saying I don’t want to struggle, I don’t want to live in a basement, I don’t want to be on the run.

Brothers, make sure you have a ride or die chick, a wife who is not Americanized, who won’t up and leave when things get hard, who has your back if somebody runs up on your house. And sisters, some of these brothers are not right either. The woman is soft and tender, but in the time we are living in, sisters have to toughen up and still keep their femininity, because a lot of suffering is about to take place.
